nobox.final_span: honest or not. The answers were mixed. Seventy-three percent of Republicans stated that they deemed their preferred candidate trustworthy. According to the poll, half of Hispanics and a quarter of Anglos stated that Cruz is honest, with just under a quarter of Hispanics also stating that O’Rourke was honest. Ipsos used a convenience sample of 1,005 self-identified “administered in English and Spanish” in Texas, according to the poll. The poll was carried out between Sept. 11 and 12. The small sample size is characteristic of Ipsos online polls, Jackson noted. But that’s not to say “there won’t be any error.” The margin of error “could be plus or minus than margin of error,” he said.
